# Karriere Fähre

> Karriere Fähre is an international placement and German-language training agency based in Douala, Cameroon. We connect motivated Cameroonian candidates with German companies and prepare them — linguistically, professionally and administratively — for an Ausbildung (dual vocational training), qualified employment, or the Chancenkarte (Opportunity Card) in Germany.

Karriere Fähre serves two audiences: candidates who want to train or work in Germany, and German companies that want to recruit qualified international professionals and apprentices. The site is trilingual: every URL below uses the French `/fr/` prefix — replace it with `/de/` for German or `/en/` for English. Service prices are not published online and are discussed individually. We never guarantee a job, a recognition or a visa; those decisions rest with the competent employers and authorities.

## Candidates — train and work in Germany
- [Candidates overview](https://karrierefaehre.com/fr/candidats): the three paths to Germany — Ausbildung, qualified employment and the Chancenkarte.
- [Ausbildung in Germany](https://karrierefaehre.com/fr/ausbildung-allemagne): dual vocational training combining classroom theory and in-company practice.
- [Ausbildung requirements](https://karrierefaehre.com/fr/ausbildung-allemagne/conditions)
- [After the Ausbildung](https://karrierefaehre.com/fr/ausbildung-allemagne/apres-ausbildung)
- [Working in Germany](https://karrierefaehre.com/fr/travailler-en-allemagne): qualified employment for experienced professionals.
- [Germany visa](https://karrierefaehre.com/fr/visa-allemagne): the main visa routes to Germany.
- [Chancenkarte (Opportunity Card)](https://karrierefaehre.com/fr/visa-allemagne/chancenkarte)
- [Skilled worker visa](https://karrierefaehre.com/fr/visa-allemagne/travailleur-qualifie)
- [Qualification recognition](https://karrierefaehre.com/fr/candidats/reconnaissance-diplomes)
- [Living in Germany](https://karrierefaehre.com/fr/candidats/vivre-en-allemagne)
- [Assess my profile](https://karrierefaehre.com/fr/evaluation): a free online orientation questionnaire.
